text:
emma: Quick thread — proposing a RefKit microseries + mini-hackday: 3 short tutorials (10-15m), a 90-min live hack session, and a single reproducible benchmark vignette. aim: low-friction onboarding for devs + measurable inbound.

raj: yes. keep tutorials tiny: Quickstart, Perf tweaks, and Embeddings example. each a single markdown + 1 GIF.

kai: benchmark narrative: compare default hosted call, local quantized run, and cached prefix pipeline. show p50/p95 + cost per 1k tokens. include `bench/` scripts and one PNG.

devon: i can provision ephemeral sandboxes. plan: forkable repo + one-click playground. will need a branch tag by next Tue. fallback: pre-recorded walkthrough.

emma: routing needs: signup -> Segment -> HubSpot campaign `refkit-microseries`; include company size and interest checkboxes (OSS, Dedicated). add UTM params for social.

raj: i'll own bench scripts and a small notebook. sample command: ```./bench/run_bench.sh --model redwood/small --seq 256 --iters 100``` will output CSV + a tiny plot.

assets-bot: Uploaded hero GIF to #marketing-assets (refkit-micro-gif.gif).

devon: provisioning plan: 40 ephemeral slots (T4-equivalent) for 2 hours on event day; snapshot image + credentials in vault. will post URL when ready.

emma: copy checklist:
- micro tutorial drafts by 5/4
- bench scripts + sample outputs by 5/6
- demo env + snapshots by 5/8
- hubspot form + email templates by 5/7
please reply with ack.

raj: ack. targeting reproducible outputs and a 1-paragraph bench summary for the blog.

kai: ack. will prepare 3 one-slide intros and a tiny Q&A doc.

devon: ack. will share deploy URL and vault path for creds.

emma: social blurbs i'll reuse across tweet, linkedin, and forum posts. tweet draft: "Try RefKit Microseries: 3 micro-tutorials + a hands-on hack session. Build, benchmark, ship. RSVP: <short.link> #RefKit #RedwoodInference"

marketing-bot: Reminder set: promo starts 5/5 (3 social pushes + 2 emails).

emma: great — closing this thread. i'll create the event page and invite. :rocket:
